# DJ Roadchanger

> Live DJ sets with saxophone and flute, piano lounge and fire shows for weddings, corporate events and private parties. Based in Riga, Latvia — available across Europe.

- Artist: Emīls Ašmanis, performing as DJ Roadchanger
- Services: DJ set with live saxophone, Roadchanger Fire Show, piano lounge; creative collaborators (live roses, live eyes, live painting); full sound system and lights
- Location: Riga, Latvia — available across Europe
- Contact: e.asmanis@gmail.com · +371 20031578
- Booking: https://roadchanger.com/#booking
- Company: SIA Mumbai, VAT LV40203627024
